checks.rule: Every source returned data; API returned all records
checks.business_reason: A missing source silently changes the denominator
checks.evidence: empty sources: none; API completeness proven in retrieve stage
checks.action: stop run if any source empty

checks.business_reason: Duplicates inflate volume and distort the SLA rate
checks.action: exact duplicates dropped (safe); conflicting ids would stop the run

checks.rule: A student's repeat submission of the same issue is not counted twice
checks.evidence: 22 same student+subject within 15 min; 22 already marked Cancelled
checks.action: Cancelled tickets excluded from KPI; the rest are NOT auto-merged (could be genuine repeats)

checks.evidence: 200 rows in DD/MM/YYYY format (email importer); unparseable after fix: 0.0%
checks.action: parsed both formats; day-first confirmed against the audit log (R06)

checks.rule: Every audit-log event belongs to a known ticket
Every ticket has a 'created' event and both systems agree on created_at
checks.business_reason: Two systems must tell the same story before we trust either; a ticket with no lifecycle cannot be timed
checks.evidence: tickets with audit-log lifecycle: 50.0%; created_at agreement within 1 min: 99.5% (DD/MM rows agree only when parsed day-first)
checks.action: source of truth for lifecycle times = audit log; stop run if lifecycle coverage < 98%

checks.rule: 'created' is the first event of every ticket (nothing happens before creation)
checks.business_reason: Out-of-order events corrupt every stage duration
checks.evidence: 3 tickets (0.3%) have events before 'created' (0 even resolved before creation); channels: {'walk_in': 3} -> walk-in desk clock skew
checks.action: excluded from KPI (not guessed); walk-in desk clock to be fixed

checks.rule: Each ticket maps to one canonical category
checks.business_reason: Department-level SLA needs a clean category
checks.evidence: 20 raw values -> 5 canonical + Unknown; representation fixes=1088, semantic mappings=142 (Academics, Exam Cell, Fees, Finance, HOSTEL, Hostel, IT), Unknown/Other=41
checks.action: semantic mappings applied provisionally; analysis uses RESOLVING department from audit log instead

checks.rule: Every status maps to a known lifecycle state
checks.business_reason: Unknown states break the KPI population

checks.rule: Every ticket has a priority (it sets the SLA target)
checks.evidence: 145 tickets (11.8%) missing priority, all email channel
checks.action: defaulted to 'Medium' per draft policy; KPI sensitivity reported

checks.rule: Tickets map to students; interactions map to tickets
checks.business_reason: Joins must not silently drop rows

checks.rule: resolved_at in ticket table = final resolution in audit log
checks.business_reason: Reopened tickets must be timed to their FINAL fix
checks.evidence: of 565 resolved tickets: 20 missing resolved_at, 48 hold the FIRST resolution (reopened)
checks.action: use audit log as source of truth; ticket-table resolved_at ignored

checks.evidence: 424 responses: 6 no ticket ref, 9 out of 1-5, 15 resubmissions (kept latest) -> 394 valid; ref formats normalised (tkt100234 / 100234 -> TKT-100234); maps to tickets 100.0%
checks.action: directional only: ~36% response rate, unhappy students respond more

checks.rule: Data is fresh enough for the decision
checks.evidence: latest event 2026-09-21 04:21; API last_synced 2026-09-21T06:00 (6h after period end)
checks.action: fit for weekly/term reporting; NOT fit for a live queue dashboard (daily batch export)

checks.rule: SLA definition is agreed by the KPI owner
checks.evidence: policy file says: 'Student Helpdesk SLA v1 (draft, not formally signed off)'; pause rule & calendar-vs-business hours not signed off
checks.action: publish as PROVISIONAL; show sensitivity to definition

fixes: Dropped 24 exact duplicate ticket rows (email importer double-sync).
Parsed 200 DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM timestamps (email importer) alongside ISO format.
CSAT: normalised ticket refs, cast string ratings to int, dropped out-of-range, kept latest per ticket.
assumptions: Semantic category mappings pending owner confirmation: Academics, Exam Cell, Fees, Finance, HOSTEL, Hostel, IT.
Missing priority (email tickets) = Medium, per draft SLA policy default.
